newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus in deal with Multichoice.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus in deal with Multichoice.

text.p: Canal Plus said its Horizons unit had signed a cooperation deal with Multichoice Africa which will broadcast from November 1 Horizon's programmes as part of its digital satellite offering for sub-Saharan Africa.
Canal Plus Horizon already broadcasts in Senegal, Tunesia and Ivory Coast.
The two companies are also studying other forms of cooperation in the Middle East and Africa.
With the deal, Multichoice Africa will have 16 channels on its digital offering, via the Panamsat satellite, which started service in May 1996.
Canal Horizon has programmes in French while MCA's M'NE and Movie Magic Channel are in English.
MCA has more than a million subscribers in sub-Saharan Africa while Horizon has 110,000 subscribers on the African continent.
